text:
Maya (Marketing): Hey team — we need a quick lock on the release announcement timeline + changelog links. Webinar invites go out Wed 9am PT, want the public post + docs link by Tue EOD. @Jamie can we hit that?

Jamie (Eng): Can do but need the exact rollout plan. Are we doing canary + region stagger?

Priya (Product): Yes — canary at 10% for 2h, then 50% for 8h, full at 24h. Regions: NA -> EU -> APAC, 2h gaps for monitoring.

Tom (Docs): I'll publish the release notes and quickstart. Draft URL: https://redwood.example.com/docs/release-v1.2 (will update). Any required snippets for marketing?

Maya (Marketing): Need 2 x short blurbs: 1) launch post headline (~12 words), 2) 2-line product note for webinar slide. Also a changelog snippet we can paste in the post.

Jamie (Eng): Changelog snippet (dev):
```
- feature: adaptive-batching UI (beta) — reduces token cost by ~20% on typical chat loads
- perf: KV cache hotpath optimizations for lower tail latency
- infra: canary routing + graceful fallback on model variant mismatch
```

Tom (Docs): I'll include that in the notes and add migration callouts. Will also add a short 'what's different' section.

Sana (Growth Ops): For inbound routing — can we tag demo leads from webinar as "launch-webinar-2026" so SDR queue rules pick them?

Priya (Product): Yes. Add a UTM and the tag. UTM: utm_campaign=launch-v1-2-webinar. Tag: launch-webinar-2026.

Maya (Marketing): Perfect. So timeline recap:
- Tue EOD: public docs + changelog link (Tom)
- Wed 9am PT: webinar invites + post draft (Maya)
- Wed 10am PT: publish post and open signups (after 1h warm-up)
- Wed 10:30am PT: begin canary (10%) (Eng ops)

Jamie (Eng): Ops note: we'll run the canary using the new routing policy:
```json
{"policy":"staged-by-region","steps":[{"region":"na","pct":10},{"region":"na,eu","pct":50},{"region":"*","pct":100}],"monitoring":"latency+error+quality"}
```
(We'll paste into infra runbook)

Maya (Marketing): Can you paste that runbook link here when ready? I'll include it in the internal launch thread.

Jamie (Eng): Posted to eng-oncall: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/launch-v1.2-canary — monitors: p50/p95, error-rate<1%, quality-regressions alert tag @ml-evals.

Tom (Docs): Docs published: https://redwood.example.com/docs/release-v1.2 — includes changelog, upgrade steps, FAQ. Ping me for wording changes.

Sana (Growth Ops): SDR tagging flow created: https://internal.redwood/crm/flows/launch-webinar-2026 — adds tag + utm + route to SDR queue.

Priya (Product): One ask: add an explicit rollback trigger if model quality drop >2% on eval set for 30m. Can we wire that to auto-fallback?

Jamie (Eng): Yes — fallback to previous model variant and scale down canary. I'll add the automated policy to the runbook.

Maya (Marketing): Last check — embargo? We want press embargo until Wed 10am PT. @Sana flag PR outreach accordingly.

Sana (Growth Ops): Noted. Press embargo Wed 10am PT. I'll hold the release list and schedule outreach after publish. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued for canary window Wed 10:20 PT — job id job-2026-6051. Status updates will be posted here.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks everyone — I'll assemble the post copy and share a draft by EOD for a quick signoff.

Jamie (Eng): If you need a 1-liner for the post: "Redwood Inference launches adaptive batching and KV cache improvements to cut costs and tighten latency tails." Use as you like.

Tom (Docs): Happy to tweak final lines.

Maya (Marketing): Great — check-in NLT 5pm PT. Thanks!"
